dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge boundary is non-continuous and heavily irregular due to multiple deep notches, preventing a standard mathematical spline fit from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as acute and sharply pointed, with a minimal pixel radius at the terminal extremity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin exhibits a steep, continuous convex arc measuring approximately 70 to 75 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 0.65:1, characterizing a tall and narrow fin profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive serrated notches and jagged excisions along the entire trailing edge of the dorsal fin; presence of scattered light-colored circular and linear depigmentation spots on the mid-body flank.
